items.stem: What does the octal permission 644 grant on a regular file?

options.text: Owner read/write; group and others read only
options.rationale: Correct: 6=rw for owner, 4=r for group, 4=r for others.

options.text: Owner read only; no access for others
options.rationale: 644 gives owner write and others read, not owner read-only.
The execute bit is not set in 644.

items.explanation: Correct: 644 is owner read/write and group/others read-only.

items.stem: Which TWO systemctl actions are needed so a service both runs now and starts automatically at boot? (Select TWO)

options.rationale: Correct: start runs the service immediately.
Correct: enable configures the service to start at boot.
mask prevents the service from starting at all.
status only reports state; it does not start or enable.

items.explanation: Correct: start runs it now and enable makes it start at boot; both are needed.

items.stem: Which command reads the logs of a specific systemd service?

options.rationale: Correct: journalctl -u filters the journal to one unit.
That file lists user accounts, not service logs.
mask disables a service; it does not show logs.

items.explanation: Correct: journalctl -u shows the journal entries for a given unit.
